overview.en: Deploy the Balanced option’s web app, PostgreSQL and file storage in Canada Central, then connect logs and secrets to operational tools.
overview.ko: 균형 안의 웹앱, PostgreSQL, 파일 저장소를 Canada Central에 배포하고 로그와 비밀 값을 운영 도구에 연결합니다.

prerequisites.en: Prepare an Azure subscription and resource group.
Prepare application code and deployment permissions.

instructions.en: Create a resource group in Canada Central using Azure Portal.
instructions.ko: Azure Portal에서 Canada Central 리소스 그룹을 만듭니다.

verification.en: Check that the resource group location is Canada Central.
verification.ko: 리소스 그룹의 위치가 Canada Central인지 확인합니다.

goal.en: Create a Linux plan to host the web app.

instructions.en: Create an App Service plan and select Linux and P0v3.
instructions.ko: App Service 계획을 만들고 Linux와 P0v3를 선택합니다.

verification.en: Check that the plan is running.

instructions.en: Create a Linux web app on the plan and configure deployment slots.
instructions.ko: 계획에 Linux 웹앱을 만들고 배포 슬롯을 구성합니다.

verification.en: Check the app response on the default domain.

goal.en: Prepare a PostgreSQL server for the app.

instructions.en: Create a flexible server and configure its firewall and database.
instructions.ko: 유연한 서버를 만들고 방화벽과 데이터베이스를 구성합니다.

verification.en: Check database connectivity from the app network.

goal.en: Store reservation files in Blob storage.

instructions.en: Create a storage account and a private Blob container.
instructions.ko: 저장소 계정과 비공개 Blob 컨테이너를 만듭니다.

verification.en: Upload and read a test file.

goal.en: Manage logs and application secrets safely.

instructions.en: Connect Log Analytics and Application Insights, then configure Key Vault references.
instructions.ko: Log Analytics와 Application Insights를 연결하고 Key Vault 참조를 설정합니다.

verification.en: Check request logs and Key Vault references.
verification.ko: 요청 로그와 Key Vault 참조가 정상인지 확인합니다.

cautions.en: Allow only required networks through the database firewall.
